messages:
Devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — capturing remediation owners, timelines, and recurring pattern notes for the GPU capacity/autoscale incident. I listed owners and suggested checkpoints below. Please ack and update if the ETA is off.
Maya: Acked. thanks for the summary. can we tighten the scheduler tuning ETA to something realistic?
Devon: Good call. Proposed timeline:
- ACTION-101 (quota guardrails): Owner @Maya, ETA 2026-04-10
- ACTION-102 (scheduler threshold tuning): Owner @Alex, ETA 2026-04-03
- ACTION-103 (headroom planner and weekly burn report): Owner @Samira, ETA 2026-03-30
- ACTION-104 (automated fallback policy test): Owner @Devon, ETA 2026-04-07
Maya: I can take ACTION-101. Will scope as: hard quota enforcement + alerting (Slack + paging) and add a dashboard tile.
Samira: ACTION-103 sounds good. I'll add a lightweight daily headroom calc job (kubernetes CronJob) and a Prometheus metric: rwd_gpu_headroom_ratio.
Alex: For ACTION-102 scheduler tuning — I want to test two knobs:
```
- max_pod_count per-zone -> 30 (from 50)
- preemptible_fallback_threshold -> 0.65 (from 0.8)
```
I'll run canary traffic for 48h and post results. ETA 2026-04-03.
Maya: For quotas, do we also want a soft-backoff before hard deny? something like 90% -> slow path.
Devon: Yes, add soft backoff at 0.9 with 30s token bucket slowdown. Put hard deny at 0.98. Add to ACTION-101 scope.
Samira: Noted. I'll include the headroom rolling window (1h, 6h, 24h) in the report so we can catch transient surges vs sustained demand.
Alex: Quick question — where do we track these actions? prefer a single tracking board.
Devon: Created GH issue board: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/pm/boards/gpu-remediation (use labels: incident, owner, eta). I'll link ACTION ids to GH issues.
ops-bot: Reminder: Oncall rotation reminder — @sre oncall starts 2026-03-20.
Maya: Small risk note: reducing max_pod_count may increase queue latency for short-lived requests. I'll run a perf eval with synthetic short-chat traffic.
Devon: Good. Let's keep perf evals in scope for ACTION-102. Also add regression alert in Redwood Console for median latency +95th.
Samira: Can we add a recurring 15-min async check-in for two weeks after rollout? quick thread updates only. I can host the calendar.
Devon: Yes, add recurring check-in: daily 09:15 for first 10 days, then weeklies for 4 weeks. Samira to create calendar invite.
Alex: I'll push the canary config tomorrow and paste the test plan here.
Maya: ETA update — ACTION-101 might slip one day; new ETA 2026-04-11. I'll update GH issue.
Devon: Noted. Final ask: everyone put a short postmortem follow-up comment in the GH issue when you close your action. That helps downstream audits.
Samira: ack. I'll add the burn-rate graph to the issue template.
Alex: ack — will paste canary metrics (error rate, p99 latency, gpu-util) when done.
Devon: Thanks all. I'll run a rollup in two weeks and capture recurring pattern learnings (burst cadence, tenant skew, scheduling hotspots). If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
